title: Knowledge bases
description: Documents, chunks, quality, versions and export/import of the corpora the agents rely on.
emptyHint: Create one, upload its documents, review them, then publish a version.
kindHint: “Global practices” feeds international precedents; “prior reports” stores earlier analyses.

wizard.next: After creation you will upload the documents, review their quality and rights, then publish a version.

welcome.title: Next steps
welcome.review: Review quality, licences and pages to re-read.
welcome.publish: Publish a version of the knowledge base.

dropHint: Drop files here (PDF, DOCX, HTML, text…) or choose them. Each file is ingested in the background.
uploadMeta: Optional metadata applied to the uploaded files
redistributionHint: Unknown or restricted documents are excluded from an open export.
coverageHint: List the documents you expect in this corpus. Any claim of absence must be read with this ratio: an absence in an incomplete corpus is never proof of non-existence.
publishHint: Publishing freezes the current set of document versions. Exercises use published versions only.
noVersionsHint: An agent cannot search a knowledge base that has no published version.
searchHint: Runs the same hybrid search as the agents (lexical + vector, fused). Shows each signal and warns when the search is degraded.
importHint: The archive is validated first (dry run: sizes, hashes, consistency). Nothing is created until you confirm.
importInvalid: Archive is invalid: nothing will be imported
newVersion: New version of an existing base

export.title: Export wizard
export.rightsHint: Redistribution status of the documents. An open publication refuses restricted and unknown documents.

modes.full_reimportable: Everything needed to re-import the base elsewhere.
modes.processed_only: Extracted text and metadata, without original files.
modes.documents_only: Documents and metadata, no index data.
modes.open_publication: Only redistributable documents. Refused if any document is restricted or of unknown licence.

retireConfirm: Retire “{{title}}”? It is refused if an exercise or a published version references it.
pagesToReviewHint: These pages have low extraction quality (scan, OCR). Check them against the original.
